summary: The script makes network requests to a third-party server (ffscouter.com) using GM_xmlhttpRequest, which is a critical risk if user data or sensitive information is transmitted. There is no evidence of code obfuscation, DOM XSS, or dangerous dynamic code execution in the provided snippet. The script requests several GM_* permissions, but their usage appears standard. The script is not approved for use in sensitive environments without further review of the full code and network behavior.
